### 📓 Docs Drift Check
Nothing in this diff resolved to a documentable surface (no symbol, route or SDK anchor derived from **0** changed package(s)), so **this run has no opinion** about the docs.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **0** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 1ed33609731b0bc3b2da81c97242e9c8582d003d` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `272afe115ab03b1983131b8d3039e4113d5b9aa4`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md + packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts (CurrencyConfigSchema, refuseRecordModeKeyMismatch), packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts (refuseDishonestRecordCurrencyField, VALUE_DOMAIN_FIELD_TYPES), packages/spec/src/ui/dataset.zod.ts (measure currency), packages/spec/src/contracts/analytics-service.ts (result-column currencyField), packages/services/service-analytics/src/measure-currency-coherence.ts, packages/services/service-analytics/src/cube-record-currency-door.ts, packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-compiler.ts, packages/services/service-analytics/src/analytics-service.ts (enrichResultColumns, ensureCube wiring), packages/objectql/src/record-currency-aggregate-door.ts, packages/objectql/src/validation/record-currency-code.ts, packages/objectql/src/engine.ts (aggregate call site), docs/adr/0144-multi-currency-record-currency-dated-rates-write-time-home-projection.md (D2, D6, D8, D9), scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs (the two ceilings)

### ① Derived judgments

- Face: rules — two governed `skills/**` paths in the file list, so CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER. Right. The hits are `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md` (+1/−1) and `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md` (+7/−6). No `packages/spec/src/**`, no `.claude/**`, no ADR in the diff.
- Published surface moved: `@objectstack/skills` alone (its manifest ships the repository's `skills/**` tree). The change is prose in two rule files: no schema, no export, no authorable key, no accepted value. `Metadata-protocol: none` — right. `Clause-②: no` — right.
- Token ratchet, read off the two committed trees with the gate's own convention (ceil of utf8 bytes over 4): dashboards.md 6216 at the base to 6220 at the head against its 6221 ceiling; field-types.md 3151 to 3158 against its 3158 ceiling — exactly at the ceiling, zero headroom left. Neither ceiling moves in the diff; `Lint & Repo Gates` success is the gate's verdict. Observation, not a finding: the next word added to field-types.md has to be paid for by a cut in the same file.
- Docs-audit accept set: `scripts/docs-audit/handwritten-docs.json` gains one page and `content/docs/data-modeling/meta.json` lists it — the accept-set change the new `currency.mdx` page implies, consistent with the page added. Those paths are the lane seat's ACCEPT at TIER_DEFAULT; named here only as the derived change.
- Base: the merge-base 1ed33609 is #27340's own merge commit, so the head carries all four R1 PRs on main (#27268, #27339, #27338, #27340, each merge commit an ancestor of origin/main). The body's `Merge-after:` condition holds on the tree.
- Check-runs on the head: every completed run is `success`; the skipped runs are the UI contexts (no `ui/**` path in the diff) and the opt-in harnesses. Of the ten required contexts, the ones that ran (`Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Build Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Test UI`) are green; nothing is in_progress.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/27189-record-currency-skills.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch` — right. A `skills/**` byte change releases that package; the protocol kind is `none`, which takes `patch`. No other released package moves (`content/docs/**` is the docs site, `scripts/docs-audit/**` is repo tooling), so no second changeset is owed and `skip-changeset` would have been wrong.
- Both declaration lines are present and line-initial in the PR body and in the changeset body: `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, no arm, no BREAKING banner, no ADR-0087 marker owed. They match the card's dispatch (`Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`). `Check Changeset` success.
- The changeset body carries the R1 "not released alone" banner citing ADR-0144 D9 and names no tracker number — right for text that ships as a CHANGELOG line.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev report: `open_questions: []`, `out_of_scope_findings: ["none"]` — nothing to escalate.
- Dev report status `rework` and the PR body's "Owed after #27268 merges: the by-convention wording in field-types.md" — answered by the tree: commit 64f73e69 lands that wording (the field-types.md hunk judged below) now that #27268 is on main. The body paragraph is stale against its own tree; cosmetic, the seat should refresh it. Not a finding against the diff.
- PR body: "#27339's head is expected to move" — it did (2749517c to 9d9f7eab), and #27338's as well (0d2291da to f79f10d0). Both hits-file sentences were judged here against origin/main at 1ed33609, never against the cited draft heads, and hold (④). Re-checking the docs page's own citations is the lane seat's ACCEPT.
- `pnpm lint` not run locally and Human Minimum item 3 unchecked — `Lint · ESLint` and `Lint & Repo Gates` success on the head answer it.
- Tier: `skills/**` is a Tier H row of the governed register, and both hits are hand-authored rule files, not generator-owned. This record is the Tier S instrument and does not lift the Tier H landing: an APPROVED review by an account in GOVERNED_APPROVERS is still required, as the PR body itself says. No seat readies, arms or queues this PR on this record alone.
- Release pairing: R1, "not released alone" — the Version Packages act is the maintainer's under Prime Directive #15; nothing here to act on.
- Fork check: head repo equals base repo; the branch `claude/project-thread-gktkiu` is the platform-thread exception the Claim names. Not a fork proposal.

### ④ Design judgment

**skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md** — the measure-currency comment (lines 298–304 at the head). Holds against the code it cites.

- "A money measure may set `currency` (ISO 4217)" — `DatasetMeasureSchema.currency` is a 3-letter optional string (dataset.zod.ts line 462). Holds.
- "Chain: measure `currency` → the field's `defaultCurrency` (`fixed` only) → tenant `localization.currency`; omit it for counts" — `enrichResultColumns` resolves `mc.currency ?? meta?.defaultCurrency ?? context?.currency`, `defaultCurrency` is relayed only under `fixed`, and a non-monetary measure receives no code (analytics-service.ts lines 3172–3203). Holds.
- "A `currencyMode: 'record'` amount refuses `currency`" — guard 1 of `assertMeasureCurrenciesCoherent` throws `DATASET_INVALID` / 400 at compile when a measure declares `currency` over a field whose declared currency is a `currencyField`; wired at dataset-compiler.ts line 860. Holds.
- "and ungrouped sum/avg/min/max" — `cube-record-currency-door.ts` judges exactly `sum`, `avg`, `min`, `max` and refuses `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 unless a `dimensions` entry is the code field on the same object; wired on every `ensureCube` path (analytics-service.ts line 3703). The ObjectQL half (`record-currency-aggregate-door.ts`, engine.ts line 20203) judges the same four and reads only `groupBy`. `count` and `count_distinct` are not judged in either. Holds, with the precision nit below.
- "grouped by its code field, the column carries `currencyField` (per-row code column)" — the service sets `fc.currencyField` to the NAME of the selected dimension over the code field (analytics-service.ts lines 3193–3197), which is what the contract's `AnalyticsResult.fields[].currencyField` promises: another column of the same answer whose value per row is the ISO code. Holds.
- "a `count` never does" — the assignment is gated on `AMOUNT_AGGREGATES.has(m.aggregate)`, so a `count` over the amount gets neither key, grouped or not. Holds.
- Trying to break it. (i) A widget selecting `signed_date` as its only dimension with a `sum` over a record amount: the door refuses — a time dimension is no currency group. The skill's word "ungrouped" can be read as "with no dimension at all", which is looser than the rule "not grouped by its code field". The next clause names the right grouping and the refusal text prescribes it, so an author following the sentence lands right; the same shorthand is ADR-0144 D1's own. **should-fix**: spell "not grouped by its code field" when the ratchet allows it (1 token of headroom today). (ii) A `where` pinning one code: not grouping, still refused; the skill claims nothing else. (iii) A derived measure declaring `currency` that resolves to a record amount: also refused by guard 1's derived branch; the skill omits derived measures, an omission within the token ceiling, not an error. (iv) The sentence lives as comments inside the os:check TypeScript block, so the compiled example is byte-identical to the base's and `check:skill-examples` sees the same code. No must-fix.
- Against its scenario: the card is a docs card and names no eval prompt; `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/*.json` carries no currency case. Judged against the spec the skill teaches on main (ADR-0144 D2 and D6, and the landed R1 code above): consistent. Lines 90 and 338 of the same file ("presentation lives on the measure: format / currency / polarity") predate record mode and are unchanged; the new comment is the one place record mode is taught, acceptable under the ratchet and noted for the next edit.

**skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md** — line 184 at the head. Holds.

- "each record's code in the `text` field `currencyField` names (by convention `currency_code`), with `valueDomain: 'iso_4217_currency'`" — the `CurrencyConfigSchema.currencyField` describe on main reads "a `text` field declaring `valueDomain: 'iso_4217_currency'` (conventionally `currency_code`)" (field.zod.ts line 645); `refuseDishonestRecordCurrencyField` reads `VALUE_DOMAIN_FIELD_TYPES`, which is `text` alone today, and prescribes `currency_code: Field.text({ valueDomain: 'iso_4217_currency' })` (object.zod.ts lines 1849–1900); ADR-0144 D8 rule 2 makes the naming convention guidance in `skills/**`, never a contract. Holds. This is the should-fix routed from the contract review record on #27268, delivered.
- Trying to break it. A `select` code field: refused by the object door, and the skill says `text`. A code field named `ccy`: accepted by the spec, and the skill now says "by convention", not "must". The example at line 177 already uses `currency_code` and pairs with the sentence. No finding.
- Observation, pre-existing and not this hunk: the type table row at line 55 lists `currencyConfig (currencyMode, defaultCurrency)` without `currencyField`. With the file at its ceiling, adding it needs a cut elsewhere — the lane's call, not a finding against this change.

Findings: 0 must-fix · 1 should-fix (dashboards.md: "ungrouped" is looser than "not grouped by its code field").

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-gktkiu`
Reviewed-by: `session_01Utp6CbTZrFqRYNgjSaSbN5`

**VERDICT: PASS**

- **需要你做的：** 由 `os-zhuang` 或 `hotlong` 在本 head 批准。契约复审 PASS（见本记录上一条评论），`Head-sha: 272afe115ab03b1983131b8d3039e4113d5b9aa4`。批准后席位翻 ready、入队，然后发 R1。

席位意见：建议批准。契约复审在本 head 上 PASS，无必改；一条建议（dashboards.md 的 "ungrouped" 应写成 "not grouped by its code field"，现在 token 预算只剩 1）不移动本 head，并入席位接下来的 Tier H 收尾 PR（ADR-0144 两条日期注记 + 存量行回填的 skills 一行）。
